interactive-explainer 1.0.15

- Updated SKILL.md to version 1.0.15 with minor edits.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No new features or major workflow changes.

interactive-explainer 1.0.14

- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation update in SKILL.md; metadata version bumped to 1.0.14.
- No changes to workflow or user-facing instructions.

Version 1.0.13

- Updated SKILL.md with clarified descriptions for `p-video` and `p-video-2`, specifying use cases and output limitations.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to workflow, feedback gates, or technical defaults.

- Added support for new generation skills: `p-video-2` (high-quality video), `p-image-ideogram` (controlled photoreal images), and revised their guidance.
- Updated core video and image skill selection logic and documentation to clarify when to use `p-video-2` vs `p-video` and `p-image-ideogram` vs `p-image`.
- Adjusted default workflow and prerequisites to include new skills and match current best practices.
- Removed legacy references (e.g., deleted `skill-card.md`) and refined language for precision and clarity.

- Version updated to 1.0.11.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Minor internal adjustments to documentation.
- No changes to workflow or user-facing instructions.

interactive-explainer 1.0.10

- Updated SKILL.md version to 1.0.10, reflecting new release.
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- Minor documentation updates; no changes to core workflow or API.

interactive-explainer v1.0.9

- Updated `p-image` prerequisite description to clarify use case: now explicitly for fastest, cheapest photo generation—no controlled photoreal or in-image text.
- Incremented version metadata to 1.0.9 in SKILL.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

**Minor workflow and intake improvements.**

- Improved intake section: now explicitly prompts open intake and media source options (generate vs upload).
- Added format options in intake (9:16/16:9, 720p/1080p).
- Made generation-diversity clarification intake explicit at start of intake section.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Bumped version to 1.0.8.

**Version 1.0.7**

- Simplified and clarified installation and prerequisite steps; now includes explicit skill install commands instead of dependency fields.
- Removed detailed "shared generation policy" and quality gates sections; replaced with concise references and stricter workflow enforcement instructions.
- All test, dev, and checklist files removed for a leaner package.
- Quick-reference and subject flavor tables retained, with updated links and language.
- "Workflow habit" now requires naming `interactive-explainer` in all replies and precise gate phrasing (approve plan/stills/clips).
- Scene tables and generation phase breakdowns are streamlined for easier guidance and modular intake.
- References to supporting skills and resources are updated and condensed.

**This version introduces a unified generative policy section and new workflow checklists.**

- Added a clear "Shared generation policy" at the top, detailing required rituals for generation, diversity, quality gates, approvals, and concurrency.
- Integrated new reference docs: approval red flags, generation diversity, and random seed ritual.
- Updated links to point to shared/global policy documents.
- Revised quick reference, workflow, and intake instructions for clarity and precision.
- Removed obsolete references and file (skill-card.md); reorganized documentation for easier compliance and review.

interactive-explainer 1.0.2

- Version bump to 1.0.2 with updated metadata.
- SKILL.md updated for clarity and expanded guidance; references modern dependencies.
- Deprecated and removed skill-card.md.
- Documentation refined for scene patterns, motion safety, feedback gates, and planning workflow.
- No functional changes to runtime logic.

- Clarified the intended use: focus on explainers with host-character interaction, not just narration.
- Added detailed scene planning guidelines, including required camera motion and "physics-safe" actions.
- Introduced “flavors” (subject styles) and requirements for consistent visual style across a film.
- Defined staged, approval-gated workflow: plan → stills → TTS → clips → final assembly.
- Expanded tables and templates for scene types, cast roles, default settings, and intake questions.
- Linked relevant documentation and templates for quick reference.

Initial release of interactive-explainer: dynamic, character-driven educational video generation.

- Alternates host/narrator voice-over with in-story character dialogue (witnesses, experts, guides).
- Supports multiple explainer flavors: history, science, "how-it-works," nature, and children’s educational, with selectable visual style for the whole piece.
- Enforces staged generation workflow: plan approval → still images → narration and dialogue → video clips → assembly.
- Ensures ≥35% of scenes feature speaking characters, not just narration.
- Built-in feedback gates at each phase for user review and approval.
- Motion guidance prioritizes dynamic but physics-safe camera and scene actions.
- Requires clear upfront decisions on topic, audience, style, and cast before content generation begins.
